“Our people are not merely [worgen](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Worgen). We are [Gilnean](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)), as we always have been, and always will be, [cursed](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Worgen_curse) or not.”

- — Queen Tess Greymane[1]

**Tess Greymane** is the Queen of [Gilneas](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)), and a member of the [Greymane clan](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Greymane_family) as the daughter of [King Genn](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Genn_Greymane) and [Queen Mia](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Mia_Greymane).[2] Once the princess of the kingdom, Tess became the rightful heir to the throne after her brother, [Prince Liam](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Liam_Greymane), was murdered by [Sylvanas Windrunner](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Sylvanas_Windrunner) during the [Battle for Gilneas City](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Battle_for_Gilneas_City). In the course of the [invasion of Gilneas](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Invasion_of_Gilneas), she and her people were exiled to the [Howling Oak](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Howling_Oak) in [Darnassus](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Darnassus) with the help of the [night elves](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Night_elf), until she moved with the royal family to [Stormwind City](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Stormwind_City). With her brother gone, she was searching for answers to questions she never thought she would ask.[3]

By the time of the [third invasion of the Burning Legion](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Third_invasion_of_the_Burning_Legion), Tess fought the [demons](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Demon) as a member of the [Uncrowned](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Uncrowned) and joined the [Council of Shadows](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Council_of_Shadows),[4] the leaders of the secret [rogue](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Rogue) organization. During the [Fourth War](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Fourth_War), she and [Lorna Crowley](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Lorna_Crowley) headed to [Darkshore](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Darkshore) on behalf of King Genn, where they led the Gilnean forces to help the [Army of the Black Moon](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Army_of_the_Black_Moon) in reclaiming their land during the [Battle for Darkshore](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Battle_for_Darkshore).[5]

Over a decade after their exile, King Genn declared that the time had come to reclaim their kingdom and gave command of the operation to Tess.[6] At the head of the Gilnean troops and their allies of the [7th Legion](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/7th_Legion), she also appealed for support from the [Desolate Council](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Desolate_Council), the [Forsaken](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Forsaken) being experts in fighting the [Scarlet Crusade](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Scarlet_Crusade). Following the [Reclamation of Gilneas](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Reclamation_of_Gilneas) and its capital, King Genn reaffirmed his faith in Tess and abdicated as the ruling king of Gilneas, declaring that his daughter would henceforth reign as the new queen of Gilneas, ready to lead their people towards a better future.[7]

## History

### Childhood

Tess was born to [Queen Mia](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Mia_Greymane) and [King Genn](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Genn_Greymane) before [Gilneas](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)) left the [Alliance of Lordaeron](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Alliance_of_Lordaeron) after the [Second War](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Second_War).[8] Her life was later saved by a potion made by the Royal Chemist [Krennan Aranas](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Krennan_Aranas); if not for him, she would have died soon after she was born.[2] When she was a little girl, her father told her that she was to find one beautiful thing every day and that it would make the hard days easier.[9] Genn was also gruff with his children and rarely told them he loved them.[10]

### Curse of the Worgen

[![Comics title.png](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/thumb/Comics_title.png/57px-Comics_title.png?427e0a)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Comics) **This section concerns content related to the *Warcraft* [manga](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Manga) or [comics](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Comics).**

[![](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/thumb/CotW_Tess_Greymane.jpg/240px-CotW_Tess_Greymane.jpg?21373a)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/File:CotW_Tess_Greymane.jpg)

After the [Cataclysm](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Cataclysm_(event)) destroyed the town of [Duskhaven](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Duskhaven), Tess ventured up to her father's observatory in [Greymane Manor](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Greymane_Manor) with a single [peacebloom](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Peacebloom) flower. She reminded Genn of the words he would tell her as a little girl, and that even among the ruined Gilneas she was able to find an unharmed peacebloom, which gave them both hope.[9]

### Cataclysm

[![Cataclysm](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/Cata-Logo-Small.png?cd16d8)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Cataclysm) **This section concerns content related to *[Cataclysm](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Cataclysm)*.**

Due to [Prince Liam Greymane](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Liam_Greymane)'s death, Tess became the heir to the Gilnean throne.[11] With her brother gone, she was searching for answers to questions she never thought she would ask.[3]

### Lord of His Pack

[![WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png?6916a4)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novels) **This section concerns content related to the *Warcraft* [novels](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novels), [novellas](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novellas), or [short stories](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Short_stories).**

During the exodus to [Darnassus](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Darnassus) in 28 [ADP](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/ADP), Tess and her mother, [Mia Greymane](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Mia_Greymane), were aboard the *[Elune's Radiance](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Elune%27s_Radiance)* while her father was on another ship. The fleet was hit by a powerful storm generated by the [Cataclysm](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Cataclysm_(event)), and the ship started to sink. Having a leg broken during the storm, Mia could not move, and Tess remained with her, refusing to leave, so they both risked drowning. Genn, refusing to lose the last two members of his family, assumed the [worgen](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Worgen) form and joined the rescue efforts of the [night elf](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Night_elf) sailors from his ship. After the storm, both women reached [Teldrassil](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Teldrassil) safely.[12]

### Legion

[![Legion](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/Legion-Logo-Small.png?7a5440)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Legion) **This section concerns content related to *[Legion](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Legion)*.**

[![](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/thumb/Darius_and_Tess_ceremony.png/320px-Darius_and_Tess_ceremony.png?65bc7e)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Darius_and_Tess_ceremony.png)

Following the [Battle for the Broken Shore](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Battle_for_the_Broken_Shore) in 32 ADP, Tess appeared on the *[Skyfire](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Skyfire)* [gunship](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gunship) that brought the [adventurers](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Adventurer) and other wounded back to [Stormwind City](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Stormwind_City). If the adventurer chose to ride a [gryphon](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gryphon) to [Stormwind Keep](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Stormwind_Keep), she and [Lorna Crowley](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Lorna_Crowley) would escort them on their own gryphons. While flying on the way, Tess confided to Lorna her concern about the lust for vengeance consuming her father, and Lorna stated that all Gilneans suffer from that rage, her [father](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Darius_Crowley) more than most. Though Tess concurred with her, she feared more deaths were sure to come, and Lorna grimly replied that such was the cost of vengeance and that Gilneas had waited for it long enough. When arriving at Stormwind Keep, Tess told the adventurer to give [High King Anduin Wrynn](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Anduin_Wrynn) their condolences for the death of [King Varian](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Varian_Wrynn). The two then quickly returned to the gunship as they were needed.[13] While Tess was then dressed in armor, it is unknown if she actually had a military role, or if it was due to formal reasons.

Afterward, Tess was seen as one of the Shadows of the [Uncrowned](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Uncrowned), within the sewers of [Dalaran](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Dalaran) in the secret [Hall of Shadows](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Hall_of_Shadows). She sent the newest Shadow of the Uncrowned after [Garona Halforcen](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Garona_Halforcen), who had gone to Stormwind City to assassinate members of a [Burning Legion](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Burning_Legion) cult and obtain the [The Kingslayers](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Kingslayers).[14]

She was also present alongside Lord Darius Crowley, and without her armor, when King Anduin commended the Alliance adventurer during a prestige ceremony for their battles against the Horde.[15]

When the Uncrowned received word of a large cave at the [Broken Shore](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Broken_Shore), where the Legion was plotting against the [Armies of Legionfall](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Armies_of_Legionfall), Tess and [Fleet Admiral Tethys](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Fleet_Admiral_Tethys) formulated a plan to stop them. With [fel](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Fel)-infused gun powder taken from the [Blacksail Crew](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Blacksail_Crew),[16] Tess and the [Shadowblade](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Adventurer) sneaked their way into the [Lost Temple](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Lost_Temple) and blew the cave up.[17] Afterwards, Tess explained that she had not yet pledged service to the Shadowblade because, while all rogues stepped into the shadows, it had been especially important that her status remained truly secret. But with the Legion's threat too great, Tess wanted to have a greater role in taking them down.[18]

### Before the Storm

[![WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png?6916a4)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novels) **This section concerns content related to the *Warcraft* [novels](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novels), [novellas](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novellas), or [short stories](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Short_stories).**

After [High King Anduin Wrynn](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Anduin_Wrynn) returned from his trip to [Ironforge](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Ironforge) and [Netherlight Temple](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Netherlight_Temple), he had dinner with [Genn Greymane](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Genn_Greymane) in [Stormwind Keep](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Stormwind_Keep). During the conversation, Genn urged Anduin to search for a queen to bear him a successor and suggested his own daughter, since Tess was close to Anduin's age and not some complete stranger. However, Anduin found the idea of an arranged marriage abhorrent and noted that Tess was a strong-willed woman with her own life, and who would likely not be particularly interested in the prospect of an arranged marriage either. Anduin internally reflected that he had heard all kinds of rumors about Tess' [actions](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Uncrowned), suggesting that she had "taken a [page or two](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Rogue)" from [Mathias Shaw](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Master_Mathias_Shaw), but he was unwilling to bring them up to Greymane, let alone after just having her be suggested as a bride.[19]

### Elegy

[![WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png?6916a4)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novels) **This section concerns content related to the *Warcraft* [novels](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novels), [novellas](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novellas), or [short stories](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Short_stories).**

During the [War of the Thorns](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/War_of_the_Thorns) in 33 ADP, when discussing who would head to [Darnassus](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Darnassus) to represent the kingdom of Gilneas, [High King Anduin Wrynn](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Anduin_Wrynn) suggested that Tess should go and aid their people. While her father [King Genn](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Genn_Greymane) agreed, he then stated that he did not know where she was at the time; instead leading to [Queen Mia](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Mia_Greymane) being sent instead.[20]

### Battle for Azeroth

[![Battle for Azeroth](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/thumb/BattleForAzeroth-Logo-Small.png/40px-BattleForAzeroth-Logo-Small.png?25e36c)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Battle_for_Azeroth) **This section concerns content related to *[Battle for Azeroth](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Battle_for_Azeroth)*.**

[![](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/thumb/Tess_Greymane_worgen.jpg/220px-Tess_Greymane_worgen.jpg?e5565f)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Tess_Greymane_worgen.jpg)

During the [Fourth War](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Fourth_War), Tess, alongside [Lorna Crowley](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Lorna_Crowley), headed to Darkshore on behalf of her father. There, surrounded by [Gilnean Royal Guards](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gilnean_Royal_Guard), she aided the [night elves](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Night_elf) of the [Army of the Black Moon](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Army_of_the_Black_Moon) in reclaiming their land, acting as a co-commander with Lorna as they led the Gilnean forces in the region. She later stated she would not just stand by while the kaldorei needed their help, citing how her mother nearly lost her life; as well as claiming that [some atrocities](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/War_of_the_Thorns) cannot go unanswered.

During the [battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Battle_at_the_Gates_of_Orgrimmar), Tess followed her father when his forces were tasked by [High King Anduin Wrynn](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Anduin_Wrynn) to flank the city alongside the western gate. After they successfully captured the Orgrimmar's entrance from the [Northern Barrens](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Northern_Barrens), she could be found sneaking on the roof of the bridge.[21]

After the end of the war in 34 ADP, Tess wished to become a [worgen](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Worgen) so she could better know the plight of her people to better rule them when she becomes queen. While her parents were against it, they asked the night elf druid [Vassandra Stormclaw](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Vassandra_Stormclaw) to help Tess understand the worgen's plight without becoming a worgen herself. In [Duskwood](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Duskwood), Vassandra called on [Goldrinn](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Goldrinn) at the [Twilight Glade](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Twilight_Glade) and the [Wild God](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Wild_God) put Tess into a dream scenario within the [Emerald Dream](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Emerald_Dream). In her dream, Tess was a worgen at the time of the [Forsaken](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Forsaken) [Invasion of Gilneas](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Invasion_of_Gilneas), where she and the [Gilnean champion](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Adventurer) relived the [battle for Gilneas City](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Battle_for_Gilneas_City). While she managed to kill the apparitions of [Nathanos Blightcaller](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Nathanos_Blightcaller) and [Dark Ranger Thyala](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Dark_Ranger_Thyala), she was unable to save her brother from his death and fell into the rage of the curse. After the champion defeated the [Essence of Rage](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Essence_of_Rage) that she manifested, and with Goldrinn's help, Tess realized that she did not need to be a worgen to understand her people, for it was being Gilnean in spite of the curse that defined them. She later promoted the Gilnean adventurer who aided her in this journey to a member of the [Greyguard](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Greyguard), in thanks and as recognition of their contribution to Gilneas.[22]

### Shadowlands

[![Shadowlands](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/thumb/Shadowlands-Icon-Inline.png/48px-Shadowlands-Icon-Inline.png?d84a63)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Shadowlands) **This section concerns content related to *[Shadowlands](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Shadowlands)*.**

Following the armistice of the [Fourth War](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Fourth_War), Tess was present in [Bashal'Aran](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Bashal%27Aran) and witnessed [Tyrande Whisperwind](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Tyrande_Whisperwind)'s speech about the [Horde](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Horde)'s defeat in [Darkshore](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Darkshore).[23]

### Dragonflight

[![Dragonflight](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/thumb/Dragonflight-Icon-Inline.png/48px-Dragonflight-Icon-Inline.png?be4c0e)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Dragonflight) **This section concerns content related to *[Dragonflight](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Dragonflight)*.**

[![](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/thumb/Tess_gates_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg/320px-Tess_gates_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg?c1afcf)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Tess_gates_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg)

During the [war against the Primalists](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/War_against_the_Primalists) in 40 ADP, Tess was amongst those who came to [Alexstrasza](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Alexstrasza)'s aid when she was attacked by [Fyrakk the Blazing](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Fyrakk). In the battle that followed, she fought alongside [Cenarius](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Cenarius), [Shandris Feathermoon](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Shandris_Feathermoon), [Maiev](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Maiev), and [Jarod Shadowsong](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Jarod_Shadowsong) against Fyrakk's forces at the [Field of Flames](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Field_of_Flames).[24] After the death of Fyrakk, she attended the gathering at [Amirdrassil](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Amirdrassil) when it bloomed on the [Dragon Isles](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Dragon_Isles) and could be found alongside some faction leaders, including [Thrall](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Thrall), [Baine Bloodhoof](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Baine_Bloodhoof), [Mayla Highmountain](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Mayla_Highmountain), [Tyrande Whisperwind](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Tyrande_Whisperwind), [Lilian Voss](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Lilian_Voss) and [Jaina Proudmoore](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Jaina_Proudmoore).[25]

As per their agreement with [Calia Menethil](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Calia_Menethil), the [Forsaken](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Forsaken) had pulled out of Gilneas. However, in their absence, the [Scarlet Crusade](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Scarlet_Crusade) moved into the area. Knowing precious little of the Scarlet Crusade, Tess made the choice to turn to the [Forsaken](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Forsaken) for aid. In response, Lilian and Calia answered, and the trio devised a plan in which the Forsaken army would serve as a distraction for the Crusade, while a small strike team sneaked into the city and opened the gates for the Gilneas army. Though initially outraged at the Forsaken presence, [Genn Greymane](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Genn_Greymane) gave command of the operation to Tess, which allowed for the plan to move forward.[26][8] While Tess and Voss joined the strike team, Calia gathered the Forsaken forces.[27]

Knowing that Voss served the Crusade in life, Tess asked if she was truly all right with clashing with her former comrades. In response, Voss thanked her for asking and admitted that the Crusade meant nothing to her and that at the moment of her death, she meant nothing to them.[28] While clashing against the Crusade, Tess had the team gather the [explosives](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Scarlet_Explosives) the Scarlets had gathered in order to turn the Crusade's own weapon against as a means to need to clear a way for their forces to advance.[29] After clashing against the Crusaders within [Gilneas City](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gilneas_City), the strike team was successful in opening the gates for the Gilnean army. As the Alliance forces surged forward, Tess used the explosives against the Crusades within [chapel courtyard](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Cathedral_Quarter) within the city.[30] Following this, Tess was amongst those that faced off against [Inquisitor Fairbell](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Inquisitor_Fairbell) within the [Light's Dawn Cathedral](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Light%27s_Dawn_Cathedral). With Fairbell's death, the Forsaken departed from the area, the Alliance successfully claimed Gilneas.[31]

[![](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/thumb/Tess_and_Genn_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg/320px-Tess_and_Genn_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg?b9ca19)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Tess_and_Genn_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg)

In the aftermath, Tess revealed that she noticed how Genn always hid from his pain and that she was always there for him, even though he never noticed. After acknowledging this and apologizing, Genn admitted that he found it hard to change as the world did, and that Tess had proven herself a thousand times over. Thus, he made the decision to abdicate his throne in favor of making his daughter queen.[7] While taking the time to process that her father had handed the kingdom to her, she directed Alliance champions to ensure that he was all right as he visited [Liam](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Liam_Greymane)'s grave.[32]

### The War Within

[![WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png?6916a4)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novels) **This section concerns content related to the *Warcraft* [novels](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novels), [novellas](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Novellas), or [short stories](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Short_stories).**

After the destruction of [Dalaran](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Dalaran) in 42 ADP, Tess was amongst the Alliance leaders who answered [Jaina](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Jaina) and [Thrall](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Thrall)'s joint meeting in [Boralus](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Boralus), where they helped organize the strike force that they could take to [Khaz Algar](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Khaz_Algar). When [Lord Danath Trollbane](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Danath_Trollbane) proposed to call on the [7th Legion](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/7th_Legion) in the [Arathi Highlands](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Arathi_Highlands), she exchanged a glance with [Magister Umbric](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Magister_Umbric), but ended up accepting the proposal after listening to the opinions of the other leaders.[33]

Months later, Tess spent [Winter Veil](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Winter_Veil) with her parents visiting her brother's grave.[34]

## Age

[![](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/images/thumb/Tess_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg/320px-Tess_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg?6183c1)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Tess_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg)

- A range of her age can be discerned from several details in books and comments in game:
  - In *[Day of the Dragon](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Day_of_the_Dragon)*, [Daval Prestor](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Daval_Prestor) ([Deathwing](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Deathwing)) remarks that [Calia Menethil](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Calia_Menethil) and [Jaina Proudmoore](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Jaina_Proudmoore) were the only daughters of reigning monarchs who were both single and beyond infancy.[36]
  - Calia states that Tess was "very young" when Gilneas left the Alliance.[8] As Gilneas left the Alliance potentially before Anduin was born, there is only a range of about two to three years in which Calia could never have known of her.
  - She is noted as being near [Anduin Wrynn](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Anduin_Wrynn)'s age,[37] placing her at least in her mid twenties as of *[Dragonflight](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Dragonflight)*. It explicitly states she is 'a few years his senior'.
  - She appears in game during year 28, using the human female model rather than that of a child. At this point, Anduin was only thirteen, for her to be near Anduin's age, she would at most be a teenager. [Vanessa VanCleef](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Vanessa_VanCleef) also uses the human female model, despite only being a teenager by the time of *Cataclysm*.
- For her to be near Anduin's age, within several years, she could not have been alive during Daval Prestor's hunt for a bride, as that would be year 8. This would place her well out of range of Anduin, who would only be born nearly ten years later. As Anduin would come to use a modified version of an adult model around his sixteenth year, Tess using the human female model is not out of place.
  - With a generous estimate of 'near Anduin's age' and 'a few years his senior', likely around 2-3 years, she would have to have been born around year 13, as Anduin was born in year 15.
    - This would have made Tess anywhere from two to five years old when Gilneas left the Alliance; giving little reason for Calia to need to meet a toddler.
  - Using this estimate, she would have been around 15-16 in *Cataclysm*.
  - With this estimate, she would have been 19-20 in *Legion*.
  - She would be roughly 27-28 years old when she was made Queen of Gilneas; only two to three years older than Anduin.

Prince **Liam Greymane** was a member of the royal family of [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)), and the son and heir of [King Genn Greymane](/wiki/Genn_Greymane). He was killed by [Sylvanas Windrunner](/wiki/Sylvanas_Windrunner) during the [battle for Gilneas City](/wiki/The_Battle_for_Gilneas_City).

## Biography

### Lord of His Pack

[![WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png](/images/WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png?6916a4)](/wiki/Novels) **This section concerns content related to the *Warcraft* [novels](/wiki/Novels), [novellas](/wiki/Novellas), or [short stories](/wiki/Short_stories).**

As a teenager, Liam often disagreed with his father and had quarrels with him, particularly over seceding from the [Alliance](/wiki/Alliance_of_Lordaeron) and constructing the [Greymane Wall](/wiki/Greymane_Wall). When the [Plague of Undeath](/wiki/Plague_of_Undeath) began to overtake [Lordaeron](/wiki/Lordaeron_(kingdom)), causing the nation to plead for aid from Gilneas, Liam rebuked his father for not sending any help to their fellow kingdom. A slightly drunken Genn — furious that his own son would question him — threw his goblet of wine across the floor, insisted that the wall would protect Gilneas from the undead, and stated that he would not risk the lives of any Gilneans by sending them to fight the [Scourge](/wiki/Scourge), just as his [own father](/wiki/Archibald_Greymane) wouldn't have. Liam accused Genn of always trying to emulate his father and that there were other ways to consider, but Genn replied that it was a prince's duty to strive to be like his father. Liam retorted that he thought it was a prince's duty to one day be a great king. The prince then took his leave, knowing that the argument was lost.

After the [Third War](/wiki/Third_War) began, Liam watched alongside Genn, Archmage [Arugal](/wiki/Arugal), and a guard captain from atop the Greymane Wall as a massive sea of the Scourge assaulted it in waves. Liam told his father that he should have listened to him. Genn — angered that his son would question him again, this time in public while he was trying to instill courage in the wall's defenders — brusquely told his son that now was not the time.[1]

### The Fall of Gilneas

[![](/images/thumb/Prince_Liam_Greymane_on_horseback_in_Gilneas_City.jpg/240px-Prince_Liam_Greymane_on_horseback_in_Gilneas_City.jpg?cfc7dd)](/wiki/File:Prince_Liam_Greymane_on_horseback_in_Gilneas_City.jpg)

Several days prior to the [Wolf Cult](/wiki/Wolf_Cult)'s attack on [Gilneas City](/wiki/Gilneas_City), [King Genn](/wiki/Genn_Greymane) ordered Liam to increase the presence of the military across Gilneas, concerned with the growing number of attacks across the kingdom, of which included the [Starlight Slasher](/wiki/Starlight_Slasher) murders. When questioned on whether these troops should be moved from the [Greymane Wall](/wiki/Greymane_Wall), King Genn refused to allow it, stating the neighboring [Forsaken](/wiki/Forsaken) would use any opportunity to exploit a weakness on the wall. Not wanting to alarm the civilians with the sudden upsurge of military forces, Liam was instructed to simply state that the [Northgate rebels](/wiki/Northgate_rebels) were acting up again.[2]

#### The Wolf Cult's attack

On the day of the [Wolf Cult](/wiki/Wolf_Cult)'s attack on [Gilneas City](/wiki/Gilneas_City), as the capital was put under complete lockdown, Prince Liam arrived with a regiment of soldiers and ordered them to secure the exits and the security perimeters for the citizens in the [Merchant Square](/wiki/Merchant_Square), while expecting to be outnumbered.[3] The prince then ordered the [Gilnean adventurer](/wiki/Worgen_(playable)) to follow the instructions of [Lieutenant Walden](/wiki/Lieutenant_Walden), however, the latter was found brutally murdered in an alley, and the worgen began to attack the district.[4] Although on Liam's order, their numbers were reduced during the fighting, the square was eventually overwhelmed by the worgen,[5] and the prince ordered the Gilnean adventurer to evacuate civilians to the [Military District](/wiki/Military_District) where his father and his troops could protect them,[6] while he and the guards would cover their retreat.[7]

Prince Liam later met with his father and the former rebel [Darius Crowley](/wiki/Darius_Crowley) in the [Greymane Court](/wiki/Greymane_Court). When Darius told Genn that some would have to remain behind to distract the worgen, in order to allow the rest of the Gilneans to evacuate from the city, Liam wished to stay behind with the [Royal Guard](/wiki/Gilnean_Royal_Guard) and protect the city. However, Crowley retorted that it would be better for Liam to accompany Genn, since they couldn't afford to have the king wondering if his son was alive or not.[8] Shortly after Darius and his rebels left to create a suicide diversion at [Light's Dawn Cathedral](/wiki/Light%27s_Dawn_Cathedral), his daughter [Lorna Crowley](/wiki/Lorna_Crowley) arrived to ask where her father was following his release. Prince Liam thus had no choice but to tell her that Darius and his men had volunteered to make a suicide diversion at [Light's Dawn Cathedral](/wiki/Light%27s_Dawn_Cathedral). In a fit of rage, Lorna threatened King Greymane with a gun, accusing him of sadistically having her father released only to have him killed for final revenge after the [Northgate Rebellion](/wiki/Northgate_Rebellion). Although the king tried to deny the accusations, Liam managed to stop her, and while she mourned the certain death of her father in the prince's arms, Genn started the evacuation of the Gilnean population towards [Duskhaven](/wiki/Duskhaven).[9]

One day later, King Greymane received a report from Prince Liam that their men had spotted worgen in the woods near Duskhaven, and that [Lord Vincent Godfrey](/wiki/Lord_Vincent_Godfrey) wished to eliminate them all. However, the king ordered that they should be captured rather than killed, since they were cursed civilians and not members of the Wolf Cult.[9] Despite all that happened, Liam still believed in his father, despite Genn's doubts, as he believed Genn could be a great leader once again if he could only regain his confidence in himself. Liam later observed the effects of [Krennan Aranas](/wiki/Krennan_Aranas)' elixir on the worgen.[10]

#### The Forsaken invasion

[![](/images/thumb/Liam_fighting_Forsaken_Curse_of_the_Worgen.jpg/320px-Liam_fighting_Forsaken_Curse_of_the_Worgen.jpg?3e8624)](/wiki/File:Liam_fighting_Forsaken_Curse_of_the_Worgen.jpg)

At some point, Liam started drinking to drown his regrets of being unable to prevent the loss of Gilneas City, but when the [Forsaken](/wiki/Forsaken) attacked [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_peninsula), he and his men fought back. As the undead troops reached Duskhaven, the alert was triggered by Liam who led the men to protect the village, while Mayor Gwen Armstead sent the adventurer to support them. The prince was overjoyed to reunite with the adventurer from Gilneas City, even though the hero had now been transformed into a worgen. On the battlefield, the prince tasked them with eliminating large numbers of enemy soldiers as well as using explosives to destroy their [abominations](/wiki/Abomination).[11][12] At the same time, King Greymane ordered Krennan to use his remaining potions on all the feral worgen they had captured. Despite Godfrey's opposition, the worgen were freed and led by Genn onto the battlefield, where they massacred the Forsaken and forced them to retreat to form a larger force. Although King Greymane wanted to continue the fight, Liam managed to convince him to leave the battlefield, as his people needed him more than ever in these dark times.[10]

While Liam was heading towards the main Forsaken army, the [Cataclysm](/wiki/Cataclysm_(event)) occurred and drowned the land near Duskhaven, and Liam assisted in rescuing drowning Gilnean soldiers and helped evacuate the village. After the earthquakes swallowed up much of the land near Duskhaven, Prince Liam ordered Mayor Armstead to begin preparations to once again evacuate the refugees to higher ground.[13] At the same time, Liam assisted in rescuing drowning Gilnean soldiers[14] and stayed with some of his men to continue the fight against the Forsaken on the remaining coasts. However, they were soon interrupted by earthquakes that destroyed what remained of the area, and the prince watched helplessly the devastation, imploring the [Light](/wiki/Light) to come to their aid.[10]

During the evacuation towards [Stormglen Village](/wiki/Stormglen_Village), the [stagecoach](/wiki/Stagecoach_Crash_Site) of Prince Liam tipped on the main road due to an [ogre](/wiki/Ogre) ambush while the members of a second coach were not so lucky, as their carriage careened over the edge of a steep hill and into the [Hailwood Marsh](/wiki/Hailwood_Marsh), where they battled [crocolisks](/wiki/Crocolisk) to stay alive. When the [worgen](/wiki/Worgen) [adventurer](/wiki/Adventurer) arrived, Liam tasked them to save all the survivors while he came up with a plan to deal with the [Servants of Koroth](/wiki/Servants_of_Koroth).[15] After the prince learned that the [Forsaken](/wiki/Forsaken) troops were after the refugees, he planned to stop them by stealing [Koroth's banner](/wiki/Koroth%27s_Banner) from his den with the help of the adventurer, and then planted it before the squadron. When [Koroth](/wiki/Koroth_the_Hillbreaker) came, he mistakenly believed that the Forsaken took the banner and slaughtered all of them in the area.[16]

- [![Liam with a beard in Curse of the Worgen.](/images/thumb/LiamCoW.jpg/94px-LiamCoW.jpg?f2fb62)](/wiki/File:LiamCoW.jpg)

Prince Liam after the loss of Gilneas City.

Liam witnesses the destruction of Duskaven by the [Cataclysm](/wiki/Cataclysm_(event)).

#### The Battle for Gilneas City

“The Forsaken think we're weak. A broken people. They think we'll roll over like a scared dog. How wrong they are. We will fight them in the fields until the last trench collapses and the last cannon is silenced. We will fight them on the streets until the last shot is fired. And when there's no more ammunition, we'll crush their skulls with the stones that pave our city. We will fight them in the alleys, until our knuckles are skinned and bloody and our rapiers lay in the ground shattered. And if we find ourselves surrounded and disarmed... wounded and without hope... we will lift our heads in defiance and spit in their faces. But we will... NEVER SURRENDER!!!!! FOR GILNEAS!!!”

- — Prince Liam Greymane's speech during the [Battle for Gilneas City](/wiki/The_Battle_for_Gilneas_City).

[![](/images/thumb/Chronicle3_Genn_and_Liam.jpg/320px-Chronicle3_Genn_and_Liam.jpg?5a8fde)](/wiki/File:Chronicle3_Genn_and_Liam.jpg)

A few days after the death of [Lord Vincent Godfrey](/wiki/Lord_Vincent_Godfrey) at [Tempest's Reach](/wiki/Tempest%27s_Reach), the Gilnean went to listen to King Greymane's speech at Livery Outpost. Shortly before, Genn revealed to Liam the truth behind [Archmage Arugal](/wiki/Archmage_Arugal)'s summoning of the worgen during the [Third War](/wiki/Third_War), including his responsibility in this decision. He also revealed how he and the other nobles relentlessly hunted the bloodthirsty beasts to extinction, without much success as he was infected during one of the hunts. Nevertheless, Liam accepted his father's revelations, leading to a reconciliation between him and his father. Before leaving, Genn told his son that he never told him that he loved him, but that he meant it every day.[10]

After the adventurer helped to reclaim [Emberstone Village](/wiki/Emberstone_Village) from the Forsaken,[17][18] Prince Liam gathered the [Gilnean Militias](/wiki/Gilnean_Militia) at the bridge between Livery Outpost and the [Merchant Square](/wiki/Merchant_Square)'s gates, where he gave an impassioned speech before leading the charge to begin the battle of Gilneas City. He then led the charge, and the Gilnean forces began clearing the area of all the Forsaken and the [Dark Ranger Elite](/wiki/Dark_Ranger_Elite) at their head. Once the district was secured, everyone headed in the direction of the [Military District](/wiki/Military_District) to continue the reconquest. They were soon blocked by [abominations](/wiki/Abomination) at the entrance to the Military District, until they received cannons in support by the citizens of Emberstone Village. Soon, they eliminated all the [Forsaken](/wiki/Forsaken) forces there and Liam united with Lord Crowley's worgen forces around [Stoneward Prison](/wiki/Stoneward_Prison), where the Forsaken unleashed upon the Gilneans one of their most powerful creations — the [mutated abomination](/wiki/Mutated_abomination) known as [Gorerot](/wiki/Gorerot). However, they took control of [Forsaken catapults](/wiki/Forsaken_catapult) and used them to take down Gorerot quickly, before continuing their assault at the [Greymane Court](/wiki/Greymane_Court).

When Liam and Crowley caught [Sylvanas Windrunner](/wiki/Sylvanas_Windrunner) herself at the Greymane Court, King Greymane and his forces came and attacked from the other side. As the tide was turning against the Banshee Queen, she used her dark powers to stun everyone in the immediate area and aimed a poisoned arrow at Genn. However, Liam jumped in front of the bowshot, saving his father from certain doom. As Sylvanas fled the scene, Liam died in the arms of his father, with the knowledge that the city had been freed from [Forsaken](/wiki/Forsaken) control.[19]

After the battle, the worgen adventurer informed the king that the Forsaken were going to use the [New Plague](/wiki/New_Plague), and Genn made the difficult choice not to pursue his son's murderer but to respect his wish to prioritize the safety of the civilians before all.[20] While the worgen adventurer bombarded the Forsaken forces at the [Northern Headlands](/wiki/Northern_Headlands), to delay their use of the blight, all the survivors were evacuated to [Aderic's Repose](/wiki/Aderic%27s_Repose) by passing through the [Undertaker's Pass](/wiki/Undertaker%27s_Pass), a subterranean passage hidden beneath a fishing shop in the district.[21][22] In the final moments of the evacuation, Prince Liam was laid to rest in a coffin in front of the patriarch's tomb. During the ceremony, King Greymane and the Crowley family paid their final respects and made a promise to him to liberate Gilneas one day.[23]

- [![King Genn mourning the death of his son.](/images/thumb/Genn_mourning_Liam%27s_death.jpg/112px-Genn_mourning_Liam%27s_death.jpg?ef44a8)](/wiki/File:Genn_mourning_Liam%27s_death.jpg)

King Genn mourning the death of his son.

### Legacy

[![WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png](/images/WoW-novel-logo-16x62.png?6916a4)](/wiki/Novels) **This section concerns content related to the *Warcraft* [novels](/wiki/Novels), [novellas](/wiki/Novellas), or [short stories](/wiki/Short_stories).**

[![](/images/thumb/What_We_Left_Behind.jpg/320px-What_We_Left_Behind.jpg?cad538)](/wiki/File:What_We_Left_Behind.jpg)

After Liam's death, Genn continued to be haunted by the memory of his son, particularly the quarrels they had and the sight of the prince's dying body after the [battle for Gilneas City](/wiki/The_Battle_for_Gilneas_City). During the exodus to [Darnassus](/wiki/Darnassus), Genn nearly drowned while saving [Mia](/wiki/Mia_Greymane) and [Tess](/wiki/Tess_Greymane) from the sinking *[Elune's Radiance](/wiki/Elune%27s_Radiance)*. After he was saved by [Talar Oaktalon](/wiki/Talar_Oaktalon), Genn told the night elf that he had been dreaming of Liam and that while there would be times when his child's death would hit him like a stone thrown at his chest, he could take comfort and pride in knowing that his son had been a wiser man than him.[1]

[![Legion](/images/Legion-Logo-Small.png?7a5440)](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Legion) **This section concerns content related to *[Legion](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Legion)*.**

In [Stormheim](/wiki/Stormheim), when Genn stole and destroyed the magical [Soulcage](/wiki/Soulcage) from [Sylvanas Windrunner](/wiki/Sylvanas_Windrunner) to prevent her from enslaving [Eyir](/wiki/Eyir), he said: *"You took my son's future, and now I've taken yours"*.[24]

[![Battle for Azeroth](/images/thumb/BattleForAzeroth-Logo-Small.png/40px-BattleForAzeroth-Logo-Small.png?25e36c)](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Battle_for_Azeroth) **This section concerns content related to *[Battle for Azeroth](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Battle_for_Azeroth)*.**

During the [battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar](/wiki/Battle_at_the_Gates_of_Orgrimmar), Genn made reference to avenging Liam when the Gilnean forces were sent to flank [Orgrimmar](/wiki/Orgrimmar) during [Varok Saurfang](/wiki/Varok_Saurfang)'s rebellion. He ultimately was outraged to find that Sylvanas had escaped yet again, denying him justice.[25][26] Liam's death was later relived by his sister, [Tess Greymane](/wiki/Tess_Greymane), in a vision granted to her by [Goldrinn](/wiki/Goldrinn) of what she could have changed as a worgen during the [battle for Gilneas City](/wiki/The_Battle_for_Gilneas_City). Tess was unable to prevent her brother's death, leading to her falling into an enraged state before being defeated and calmed by the worgen hero assisting her. She forlornly realized that she couldn't have saved Liam either, before coming to terms with her reasons for seeking out the [worgen curse](/wiki/Worgen_curse).[27]

[![Dragonflight](/images/thumb/Dragonflight-Icon-Inline.png/48px-Dragonflight-Icon-Inline.png?be4c0e)](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Dragonflight) **This section concerns content related to *[Dragonflight](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Dragonflight)*.**

As Genn once promised, the Gilneans eventually managed to retake the city over a decade after their exile. Following the [Scarlet Crusade](/wiki/Scarlet_Crusade)'s defeat, his sister and father reflected on how they never healed from his death, and still missed Liam.[28] Genn then made his way to Liam's grave, where he reflected on the past, and expressed that Gilneas was now in the best of hands, with Tess as the new Queen of the kingdom.[29]

[![Comics title.png](/images/thumb/Comics_title.png/57px-Comics_title.png?427e0a)](/wiki/Comics) **This section concerns content related to the *Warcraft* [manga](/wiki/Manga) or [comics](/wiki/Comics).**

Following the destruction of [Dalaran](/wiki/Dalaran), Genn, Mia, and Tess spent [Winter Veil](/wiki/Winter_Veil) that year visiting Liam's grave.[30]

## Notes and trivia

[![](/images/thumb/Prince_Liam_HS.jpg/320px-Prince_Liam_HS.jpg?72a3bc)](/wiki/File:Prince_Liam_HS.jpg)

- As Liam was a young teenager during the [Greymane Wall](/wiki/Greymane_Wall) going up and the [Scourge](/wiki/Scourge) attacking it; he would have been in his mid-twenties when he died.
- The speech made by Liam before the battle in Gilneas City is reminiscent of [Winston Churchill](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winston_Churchill)'s speech in the House of Commons on June 4, 1940, during the Battle of Britain. Faced with overwhelming odds, Churchill vowed that *"we shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the landing grounds, we shall fight in the fields and in the streets, we shall fight in the hills; we shall never surrender"*.
- He wielded a ![](/images/thumb/Inv_weapon_rifle_03.png/16px-Inv_weapon_rifle_03.png?d5cab2) [[Rough Boomstick]](/wiki/Rough_Boomstick) during the *[Cataclysm](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Cataclysm)* beta, but wields a normal Gilnean rifle in the live version of the game.
- Liam is voiced by [Zach Appelman](/wiki/Zach_Appelman).
- Liam's ghost appears as [a legendary card](https://hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Prince_Liam) for the paladin class in the *[The Witchwood](/wiki/Hearthstone:_The_Witchwood)* expansion for *[Hearthstone](/wiki/Hearthstone_(game))*. His flavor text reads: *"I have a very particular set of skills. Skills that make me a nightmare for witches like you."* In *Hearthstone* lore, Liam's spirit is rumored to appear and help people in great danger, perhaps because he failed Gilneas once before and a desire to do better fetters him to the mortal plane, or perhaps because the curse of the Witchwood denies him eternal rest. Whatever the case, this version of Liam is not done serving Gilneas.[31]

**Lorna Crowley** is the daughter of Lord [Darius Crowley](/wiki/Darius_Crowley), who was one of the principal leaders during the [Northgate Rebellion](/wiki/Northgate_Rebellion). After the retaking of [Gilneas City](/wiki/Gilneas_City), she joined her father as commander of the [Gilneas Liberation Front](/wiki/Gilneas_Liberation_Front). When the [Burning Legion](/wiki/Burning_Legion) returned to assault Azeroth, Lorna and Darius joined [Genn Greymane](/wiki/Genn_Greymane) on the *[Skyfire](/wiki/Skyfire)* as part of his army forces.

## Background

### Fall of Gilneas

[![Comics title.png](/images/thumb/Comics_title.png/57px-Comics_title.png?427e0a)](/wiki/Comics) **This section concerns content related to the *Warcraft* [manga](/wiki/Manga) or [comics](/wiki/Comics).**

[![Cataclysm](/images/Cata-Logo-Small.png?cd16d8)](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Cataclysm) **This section concerns content related to *[Cataclysm](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Cataclysm)*.**

[![](/images/thumb/Lorna_Crowley.jpg/130px-Lorna_Crowley.jpg?7827a6)](/wiki/File:Lorna_Crowley.jpg)

[![](/images/thumb/Exodus_Carriage.jpg/320px-Exodus_Carriage.jpg?738c04)](/wiki/File:Exodus_Carriage.jpg)

The day of the [worgen](/wiki/Worgen) attack on Gilneas City, Lorna saved a worgen adventurer by shooting [Josiah Avery](/wiki/Josiah_Avery). The two of them worked together to get the [Northgate rebels](/wiki/Northgate_rebels)' hidden arsenal for Greymane's army.

Shortly after, she met with [King Genn](/wiki/Genn_Greymane) and [Prince Liam](/wiki/Liam_Greymane) after her father chose to stay behind in the [Light's Dawn Cathedral](/wiki/Light%27s_Dawn_Cathedral) and make a [last stand](/wiki/Last_Stand_(quest)) against the worgen. She had received word her father was free, but Liam told her about the choice Darius made. Lorna pulled out her gun and took aim at Genn, cursing at him and believing this was his idea of revenge after the [Northgate Rebellion](/wiki/Northgate_Rebellion). Liam restrained her, and a hysterical Lorna demanded she be let go to die with her father before she began to cry in Liam's arms. Afterward she returned to the [Crowley Orchard](/wiki/Crowley_Orchard) and lived as a hermit. Before being evacuated, she and the worgen adventurer worked together to rescue some horses. She then moved to the [Greymane Manor](/wiki/Greymane_Manor) and from there she took a carriage with [Gwen Armstead](/wiki/Gwen_Armstead) to [Stormglen](/wiki/Stormglen) where she found a diary of [Bradshaw](/wiki/Bradshaw) and learned that the man ventured into [Blackwald](/wiki/Blackwald). She sent him there only to find the night elf [Belysra Starbreeze](/wiki/Belysra_Starbreeze) along with other worgen. Darius was revealed to have had survived and become a worgen. He was worried how Lorna would respond to his curse, but she was fine with it.

She was then sent to [Livery Outpost](/wiki/Livery_Outpost) to rescue the villagers from northern Gilneas and free [Emberstone Village](/wiki/Emberstone_Village). Lorna then aided the [Worgen adventurers](/wiki/Worgen_(playable)) in retaking Gilneas City after the first assault of the Forsaken. After the death of Liam, she learned that the Forsaken were going to use the plague on the city. She was present at Liam's funeral in [Aderic's Repose](/wiki/Aderic%27s_Repose). After that she moved to [Keel Harbor](/wiki/Keel_Harbor) and loaded explosives onto an [Orc Gunship](/wiki/Gunship) and [used it as a ram](/wiki/Endgame_(quest)) to destroy the Forsaken forward camp next to the [Greymane Wall](/wiki/Greymane_Wall).

### Gilneas Liberation Front

Following the [invasion of Gilneas](/wiki/Invasion_of_Gilneas), Lorna joined her father as commander of the [Gilneas Liberation Front](/wiki/Gilneas_Liberation_Front) and fought with the [Alliance](/wiki/Alliance) to retake the [Ruins of Gilneas](/wiki/Ruins_of_Gilneas) from the Forsaken. She attacked the [Forsaken Forward Command](/wiki/Forsaken_Forward_Command) as she used ![](/images/thumb/Inv_gizmo_healthpotionpack.png/16px-Inv_gizmo_healthpotionpack.png?965787) [[Forsaken Communication Device]](/wiki/Forsaken_Communication_Device) to declare that the Alliance once again controlled Gilneas and their forces would soon arrive to kill those that would not surrender.[2] However, while stationed in [Silverpine Forest](/wiki/Silverpine_Forest) she was captured by the now-[Forsaken](/wiki/Forsaken) [Lord Godfrey](/wiki/Vincent_Godfrey). Lorna served as the bargaining chip in the surrender of the Gilneas Liberation Front as [Sylvanas](/wiki/Sylvanas_Windrunner) gave Darius two choices; surrender or have Lorna turned into a member of the Forsaken. Darius, unwilling to allow such a fate to befall his daughter, agreed to the surrender, and ordered the retreat towards the still contested territory of Gilneas.[3]

### Legion

[![Legion](/images/Legion-Logo-Small.png?7a5440)](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Legion) **This section concerns content related to *[Legion](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Legion)*.**

[![](/images/thumb/Lorna_Crowley_Legion.jpg/160px-Lorna_Crowley_Legion.jpg?596cf5)](/wiki/File:Lorna_Crowley_Legion.jpg)

Following the [Battle for the Broken Shore](/wiki/Battle_for_the_Broken_Shore), Lorna and her father Darius joined [Genn Greymane](/wiki/Genn_Greymane) on the *[Skyfire](/wiki/Skyfire)*. Lorna and [Princess Tess](/wiki/Tess_Greymane) escorted the adventurer to the [Stormwind Keep](/wiki/Stormwind_Keep), conversing on the way. When flying to Stormwind Keep, Princess Tess Greymane confided to Lorna her concern about the lust for vengeance consuming her father. Lorna states that all Gilneans suffer from that rage, her father more than most. Though Tess concurs with Lorna, she fears more deaths are sure to come. Lorna grimly replies that such is the cost of vengeance and that Gilneas has waited for it long enough. When arriving at Stormwind Keep, Tess tells the adventurer to give King [Anduin](/wiki/Anduin_Wrynn) their condolences for the death of his father [Varian Wrynn](/wiki/Varian_Wrynn). The two quickly return to the gunship once the player lands, as they are needed back at the ship.[4]

The [Gilneas Brigade](/wiki/Gilneas_Brigade) led by Lorna and her father Darius established [Greywatch](/wiki/Greywatch) to secure [Stormheim](/wiki/Stormheim) from threats.

During the Skyfire's assault on Sylvanas Windrunner's fleet, Lorna led the Alliance boarding party in scouring Windrunner's ships in their search for the Banshee Queen. After discovering that Sylvanas traveled to [Stormheim](/wiki/Stormheim) ahead of the fleet and that the Horde was planning on infiltrating the Skyfire, Lorna and her soldiers went back to the Skyfire to defend the ship. Unfortunately, the Horde succeded in setting fire to the Skyfire's ammunition and its explosions caused the Skyfire to crash and burn on Stormheim. Though the crew of the Skyfire was able to evacuate before the crash, the gunship was utterly destroyed.

Lorna regrouped with her Gilneas Brigade compatriots and acted as leader of Greymane's scouts in [Lorna's Watch](/wiki/Lorna%27s_Watch). Lorna and her Gilneas Brigade scouts would aid Greymane's mercenaries in undergoing the various ancient trials necessary to obtain the [Aegis of Aggramar](/wiki/Aegis_of_Aggramar). Following a lead on Sylvanas, Lorna would scout [Skold-Ashil](/wiki/Skold-Ashil) on Greymane's orders to uncover what Sylvanas seeks there. Lorna discovers that Sylvanas means to undergo the rituals of ascension to be granted an audience with [Eyir](/wiki/Eyir) so that she could subjugate her and create more [Val'kyr](/wiki/Val%27kyr). Lorna sends news of her findings to Genn so that he could confront Sylvanas personally and undermine her plot. Greymane succeeded in freeing Eyir and Lorna recovers a poisoned Genn and treats him back at Greywatch.

### Battle for Azeroth

[![Battle for Azeroth](/images/thumb/BattleForAzeroth-Logo-Small.png/40px-BattleForAzeroth-Logo-Small.png?25e36c)](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Battle_for_Azeroth) **This section concerns content related to *[Battle for Azeroth](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Battle_for_Azeroth)*.**

| [![](/images/thumb/Stub.png/17px-Stub.png?fdeef6)](/wiki/File:Stub.png) | This section is **a [lore](/wiki/Lore) stub**. |
|---|---|
Lorna was present at the war council in [Stormwind Keep](/wiki/Stormwind_Keep).[5] She later participated in the [Battle for Darkshore](/wiki/Battle_for_Darkshore).

Lorna followed her king when they were tasked into assaulting [Orgrimmar](/wiki/Orgrimmar)'s [western gate](/wiki/Talon_Gate) while [Anduin Wrynn](/wiki/Anduin_Wrynn) and [Varok Saurfang](/wiki/Varok_Saurfang)'s forces assaulted the [main gates](/wiki/Gates_of_Orgrimmar). Due to the [mak'gora](/wiki/Mak%27gora) between [Sylvanas Windrunner](/wiki/Sylvanas_Windrunner) and Saurfang, they did not assault the city.

### Shadowlands

[![Shadowlands](/images/thumb/Shadowlands-Icon-Inline.png/48px-Shadowlands-Icon-Inline.png?d84a63)](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Shadowlands) **This section concerns content related to *[Shadowlands](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Shadowlands)*.**

Lorna was present in [Bashal'Aran](/wiki/Bashal%27Aran) and witnessed Tyrande's speech about the Horde's defeat in [Darkshore](/wiki/Darkshore).[6]

### Dragonflight

[![Dragonflight](/images/thumb/Dragonflight-Icon-Inline.png/48px-Dragonflight-Icon-Inline.png?be4c0e)](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Dragonflight) **This section concerns content related to *[Dragonflight](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Dragonflight)*.**

[![](/images/thumb/Darius_and_Lorna_-_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg/320px-Darius_and_Lorna_-_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg?72809b)](/wiki/File:Darius_and_Lorna_-_Reclamation_of_Gilneas.jpg)

During the [Reclamation of Gilneas](/wiki/Reclamation_of_Gilneas), Lorna was seen fighting in [Cathedral Quarter](/wiki/Cathedral_Quarter) of [Gilneas City](/wiki/Gilneas_City) against the members of the [Scarlet Crusade](/wiki/Scarlet_Crusade) next to her father, Darius. Afterward, she is seen in the inn at [Greymane Court](/wiki/Greymane_Court).

## Lock the Doors

[![](/images/thumb/CotW_Lorna_Crowley.jpg/160px-CotW_Lorna_Crowley.jpg?43edb8)](/wiki/File:CotW_Lorna_Crowley.jpg)

Gilneas

- Dear [Margaret](/wiki/Margaret),
I heeded your advice from last week to board up my windows and buy a reinforced door. None too soon, either: the [Starlight Slasher](/wiki/Starlight_Slasher) struck a household not two blocks from my own last night. I inquired with the authorities at the scene about what they're doing to reign in the murder spree, but they didn't even grant me a second glance, waving me off with the usual "Stay off the streets and lock your door!" I know most of them don't trust me, but they're not proving to be trustworthy themselves, either.

Well, I'm not one to sit around, waiting to get dragged off in the middle of the night! I've started training the [mastiff](/wiki/Mastiff) pups I bought from [Rupert](/wiki/Rupert) on a lark last month to track a scent, and they've taken to it quite well. They'll make fine hunting and guard dogs soon, so I'll be happy to pass on off to you once they're able to track a scent decently: they're right pleasant company, it'll help your young ones sleep better. That's at least a month off, though, so just consider the offer for now.

Which brings me to the reason for this letter: the attached package is a blunderbuss, so be sure to unwrap it at home and keep it somewhere hidden, but accessible. I threw some spare powder and buckshot in there too - no, no need to thank me. You helped [my father](/wiki/Darius_Crowley) when he was in a rough spot, and [Crowleys](/wiki/Crowley) never forget kindness freely given. Take the gun and keep safe. I fear things are going to get worse before they get better.

Sincerely,

 Lorna Crowley[7]

## Notes and trivia

- She can be seen using a rifle or a sword / shield combination.
  - Lorna's actual class seems to shift depending on her appearances, being seen using warrior abilities and hunter abilities. In one strange instance, she also uses a [rogue](/wiki/Rogue) ability in the form of Backstab.
- Despite being from Gilneas and involved with the Gilneas Liberation Front, Lorna shows no signs of being afflicted by the [worgen curse](/wiki/Worgen_curse). Indeed, during their confrontation in ![H](/images/Horde_15.png?c852a8) [5-30] [Cities in Dust](/wiki/Cities_in_Dust), Sylvanas specifically points this out to Darius, asking him why he did not offer his blood to her to make her a worgen (and thus immune to Val'kyr resurrection) if he truly cared for her. It is likely because he did not want his daughter to be afflicted with the Curse of the Worgen, as he is.
- According to [Astrid Langstrump](/wiki/Astrid_Langstrump) when spoken to without being exalted with Gilneas, Lorna continues to breed and supply her people with ![](/images/thumb/Ability_mount_ridinghorse.png/16px-Ability_mount_ridinghorse.png?ddceb2) [[Mountain Horse]](/wiki/Mountain_Horse) steeds, and would be upset should Astrid to sell it to anyone not exalted with their people. Given Lorna's current location in Gilneas, it would explain why Astrid is taking care of distribution of the horses in her stead.
- Lorna tends to have a rose in her hair when in civilian clothing.
- During the *[World of Warcraft: Cataclysm](/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Cataclysm)* beta she was watched over by a [Son of Goldrinn](/wiki/Son_of_Goldrinn) while staying at the [Crowley Orchard](/wiki/Crowley_Orchard).
- Lorna is voiced by [Gillian Wiggin](/wiki/Gillian_Wiggin).
